meta.title: The Trail Poster
meta.textType: a poster with facts and numbers

paragraphs: On Thursday, Leo made a poster for the school hall. It was about the two walking paths in the nature park. Ranger Mark gave the club all the facts and numbers. Leo drew two small trees and a big green hill. Lily wrote the title in big letters. The poster included a small map, and Leo used green, blue, and yellow pens. Teacher Kim looked at the poster and smiled.

This is the first part of the poster. "THE NATURE PARK PATHS" "Be an explorer!" "The park is open every day, except Monday." "Open from eight o'clock to five o'clock." "Children under ten walk with an adult." "The park has two paths, and both paths start at the same gate."

This is the second part of the poster. "The Blue Path: two kilometers, one hour." "This path is easy, and it goes next to the lake." "The Green Path: four kilometers, two hours." "This path is difficult, because it goes up a hill." "The Green Path is twice as long as the Blue Path." Both paths are open all day, and the gate is next to the car park. Leo looked at the numbers and asked a question. "How long is the walk if we go on both paths?" he asked. "It is three hours," said Lily.

This is the last part of the poster. "Advice from Ranger Mark:" "Wear good shoes, and bring a bottle of water." "Stay on the path, and do not touch the plants." "Read more on Explorers' Blog. The link is on the school page." "Lily writes about each walk in her diary." Leo laughed when he read the last line, and he looked at Lily. "Is that true, Lily?" he asked.

Lily laughed, too. "Yes, I write in my diary every Sunday," she said. "Which path do you like?" asked Leo. "I like the Blue Path, because the lake is beautiful," said Lily. "I agree," said Leo. "The Green Path is too difficult for the younger children." Teacher Kim put the poster on the wall of the hall. Many children stopped to read the numbers. Lily wrote the facts for her diary on a small piece of paper.
text.summary: Leo makes a poster about two walking paths in the nature park. The poster gives the length, the time, and the opening hours, and Lily chooses a path for the club.
